mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hyperlink_task_runtime (hyperlink_task_id, is_enabled, run_status, provision_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{hyperlinkTaskId}, #{enabled}, #{runStatus}, #{provisionStatus}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM hyperlink_task_runtime WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} FOR SHARE
SELECT * FROM hyperlink_task_runtime WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE hyperlink_task_runtime SET is_enabled=#{enabled}, run_status=#{runStatus}, execution_duration_sec=execution_duration_sec+CASE WHEN run_status=1 AND #{runStatus} IN (2,3,4) AND active_since_at IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(0,FLOOR((#{now}-active_since_at)/1000)) ELSE 0 END, provision_status=#{provisionStatus}, started_at=CASE WHEN #{runStatus}=1 AND started_at IS NULL THEN #{now} ELSE started_at END, active_since_at=CASE WHEN #{runStatus}=1 THEN #{now} WHEN #{runStatus} IN (3,4) THEN NULL ELSE active_since_at END, finished_at=CASE WHEN #{runStatus} IN (2,4) THEN #{now} ELSE finished_at END, updated_at=#{now} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND is_enabled=#{expectedEnabled} AND run_status=#{expectedRunStatus}
UPDATE hyperlink_task_runtime SET provision_status=3, failure_code=#{failureCode}, failure_reason=#{failureReason}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId}

UPDATE hyperlink_task_runtime SET provision_status=1, failure_code=NULL, failure_reason=NULL, updated_at=#{now} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND is_enabled=1 AND run_status=0 AND provision_status=3

UPDATE hyperlink_task_runtime SET provision_status=2, recipient_total=#{recipientTotal}, current_round_id=#{roundId}, current_round_no=1, failure_code=NULL, failure_reason=NULL, updated_at=#{now} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND provision_status=1

UPDATE hyperlink_task_runtime r SET recipient_total=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId}), send_total=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND x.submitted_at IS NOT NULL), success_num=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND x.send_status BETWEEN 3 AND 5), delivered_num=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND x.send_status BETWEEN 4 AND 5), read_num=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND x.send_status=5), fail_num=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND x.send_status IN (6,7)), fail_404_num=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND x.send_status=7), invalid_account_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_account_usage u WHERE u.hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND u.invalid_at IS NOT NULL), used_account_count=(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x.account_id) FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND x.account_id IS NOT NULL), last_send_at=(SELECT MAX(x.submitted_at) FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId}), actual_concurrency=COALESCE((SELECT x.actual_concurrency FROM hyperlink_task_round x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY x.round_no DESC LIMIT 1),0), metrics_updated_at=#{now}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE r.hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId}

UPDATE hyperlink_task_runtime SET send_total=send_total+#{delta.sendDelta}, success_num=success_num+#{delta.successDelta}, delivered_num=delivered_num+#{delta.deliveredDelta}, read_num=read_num+#{delta.readDelta}, fail_num=fail_num+#{delta.failedDelta}, fail_404_num=fail_404_num+#{delta.fail404Delta}, invalid_account_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_account_usage u WHERE u.tenant_id=#{delta.tenantId} AND u.hyperlink_task_id=#{delta.taskId} AND u.invalid_at IS NOT NULL), used_account_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_account_stat s WHERE s.tenant_id=#{delta.tenantId} AND s.hyperlink_task_id=#{delta.taskId} AND s.account_id IS NOT NULL), last_send_at=CASE WHEN #{delta.lastSendAt} IS NULL THEN last_send_at WHEN last_send_at IS NULL THEN #{delta.lastSendAt} ELSE GREATEST(last_send_at,#{delta.lastSendAt}) END, metrics_updated_at=#{now}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{delta.tenantId} AND hyperlink_task_id=#{delta.taskId}

UPDATE hyperlink_task_runtime SET is_enabled=#{targetEnabled}, run_status=0, provision_status=1, current_round_id=NULL, current_round_no=0, failure_code=NULL, failure_reason=NULL, updated_at=#{now} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND run_status=0 AND provision_status IN (2,3)

UPDATE hyperlink_task_runtime SET is_enabled=0, provision_status=0, current_round_id=NULL, current_round_no=0, recipient_total=0, failure_code=NULL, failure_reason=NULL, updated_at=#{now} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND is_enabled=0 AND run_status=0 AND provision_status=1

UPDATE hyperlink_task_runtime SET run_status=1, current_round_id=#{roundId}, current_round_no=#{roundNo}, actual_concurrency=#{actualConcurrency}, started_at=COALESCE(started_at,#{now}), active_since_at=#{now}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND is_enabled=1 AND run_status=0 AND provision_status=2

UPDATE hyperlink_task_runtime SET current_round_id=#{roundId}, current_round_no=#{roundNo}, actual_concurrency=#{actualConcurrency}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND is_enabled=1 AND run_status IN (0,1,3) AND provision_status=2

UPDATE hyperlink_task_runtime r SET run_status=2, finished_at=#{now}, execution_duration_sec=execution_duration_sec+CASE WHEN active_since_at IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(0,FLOOR((#{now}-active_since_at)/1000)) ELSE 0 END, active_since_at=NULL, actual_concurrency=0, updated_at=#{now} WHERE r.hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND r.is_enabled=1 AND r.run_status=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND x.send_status IN (1,2)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hyperlink_task_account_usage u WHERE u.hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND u.in_flight_count>0)

UPDATE hyperlink_task_runtime SET run_status=4, finished_at=#{now}, execution_duration_sec=execution_duration_sec+CASE WHEN run_status=1 AND active_since_at IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(0,FLOOR((#{now}-active_since_at)/1000)) ELSE 0 END, active_since_at=NULL, actual_concurrency=0, updated_at=#{now} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND is_enabled=1 AND provision_status=2 AND run_status IN (0,1,3)
mapper.select: SELECT r.tenant_id, r.hyperlink_task_id AS task_id FROM hyperlink_task_runtime r WHERE r.is_enabled=1 AND r.run_status=1 AND r.provision_status=2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hyperlink_task_round x WHERE x.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND x.hyperlink_task_id=r.hyperlink_task_id AND x.round_status IN (1,2,3,4,5,7)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x WHERE x.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND x.hyperlink_task_id=r.hyperlink_task_id AND x.send_status IN (1,2)) ORDER BY r.updated_at, r.hyperlink_task_id LIMIT #{limit}
